unityBridge.description: Local bridge server connecting AI to Unity Editor for scene capture, object manipulation, and play mode control.

agentInstructions:
This project has an AI Bridge system for Unity scene analysis and fixing. See .opencode/skills/ai-scene-agent/ for the behavior loop. Before making changes to the Unity scene, always: (1) capture screenshots via the bridge server, (2) analyze visually, (3) query current scene data, (4) apply fixes, (5) re-capture to verify.

Be proactive — don't wait for step-by-step instructions. If you see something that needs fixing (e.g. broken scene, missing component, build error), propose and execute a fix. If the user asks to do something, identify and do all the sub-steps needed without asking for confirmation on each one. Run parallel tool calls when possible. Always think ahead and take initiative.
